title: ArcBest Offers All-Risk Shippers’ Interest Insurance for LTL Brokerage Shipments
summary: ArcBest customers can now add All-Risk Shippers’ Interest Insurance to eligible LTL brokerage shipments.
body_markdown:
## Additional protection now available for eligible LTL brokerage shipments


ArcBest customers can now add All-Risk Shippers’ Interest Insurance when booking eligible LTL brokerage shipments. The new offering expands protection options available for ArcBest’s LTL brokerage solution and is responsive to customer feedback.


With All-Risk Shippers’ Interest Insurance, coverage is broader than a carrier’s legal liability and may help protect qualifying shipments against covered loss or damage events while freight is in transit. For coverage details, eligibility requirements and excluded commodities, visit our[Additional Coverage Options](https://arcb.com/additional-coverage-options) page.


Customers can add the coverage when booking through[ArcBest View](https://view.arcb.com/) , arcb.com and Omega.


Questions?Contact our team .


**Learn more:**[Freight Liability Coverage Explained](https://arcb.com/blog/freight-liability-coverage-explained)


## Important coverage information


All-Risk Shippers’ Interest Insurance is available for eligible LTL brokerage shipments and is subject to applicable policy terms, exclusions and limitations. Coverage must be purchased at the time of booking. When selected, the coverage is coordinated by ArcBest for the shipper’s benefit. All-Risk Shippers’ Interest Insurance is offered through McGriff Insurance Services, Inc., or one of its legal affiliates, acting as the insurance agent.
